1 ταῖς ἀγραῖς ('in the fields') the codex has, corrected to τοῖς ἀγροῖς ('in the fields'); μαγείου ('of the cook') the codex has, corrected. 3 τῇ ('the') omitted by the codex.
4 ἅπας ('all') <sic> the codex has, τόπους ('places') from the following I have written, ἀπάρας ('having departed') conjectured by Kroll. 5 ποτ’ ('ever') the codex has,
πόλεως ('of the city') I have written. 8 αἰγιάλοις παραθαλκεσίαν ('coastal beaches' [corrupt]) the codex has, αἰγιαλοῖς παραθαλασσίοις ('coastal beaches')

I have supplied. 10 δέσμοις ἢ ἐργαστηρίοις ('in bonds or workshops') conjectured by Kroll. 11 ὑπόγειον ('subterranean') the codex has, ειος ('-eios') I have written.

summary.headline: Katarchē for Letters Brought
summary.text: Astrological rules locate a hidden person by the zodiac sign and by subterranean planets, horoscopos, midheaven, and western orientation. Item 87 presents a katarchē for letters brought in Diocletian year 204, listing planetary degrees, lots, nodes, decans, twelfth-parts, and preliminary judgments.
